description: The plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for different configurations of the SepLLM model, compared to a baseline “Vanilla before post-training” model. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from approximately 95,000 to 125,000 iterations, with major gridlines at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.0 to 2.8, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.2. Four distinct lines are plotted: a pink solid line representing “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)” starts at a loss near 2.8 at 95,000 iterations and steadily declines to approximately 2.22 by 125,000 iterations; a dark blue solid line for “SepLLM (n=128)” begins near 2.8 and decreases to about 2.28; an orange solid line for “SepLLM (n=64)” starts near 2.8 and drops to roughly 2.26; and a red dashed horizontal line for “Vanilla before post-training” remains constant at approximately 2.34 across all iterations. All SepLLM variants show a consistent downward trend in loss, with the pink line (n=64, larger lr) achieving the lowest final loss, while the vanilla model’s loss remains unchanged, indicating no training progress.
